title: Full Operational Health Check
question: Give me a full health check of our supply chain: orders, shipments, inventory, supplier performance. Where are the risks and what should I act on this week?

critical_facts: Low stock (PROD-001, PROD-005, PROD-008) is surfaced
Supplier reliability concern for SUP-002 is noted
At least one cross-system insight is drawn (e.g., ORD-007 stuck because PROD-001 low, or SHP-009 failed due to carrier mismatch)
important_facts: Concrete prioritized actions are proposed, not just a list
Positives (reliable suppliers, orders on track) are acknowledged
